report_identity.report_title: Value Partners Group Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: Value Partners is a Hong Kong-listed independent asset management group offering equities, fixed income, alternatives, multi-asset and quantitative investment solutions.

segments.business_substance: One reportable segment deriving revenues from investment management services to investment funds and managed accounts.

business_overview.revenue_model: Management fees, front-end fees and performance fees, partly offset by distribution fee rebates; other income includes interest, dividends and investment property rental income.
business_notes: AUM was US$5.110bn at 2024 year end, down 8.3% from 2023.
The group operates regulated asset-management entities in Hong Kong, Singapore, Mainland China and the UK.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Proprietary investment realized and unrealized gains.
non_recurring_items.source: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income and financial review

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Foreign exchange losses included in other gains/losses.

non_recurring_items.item: Share of losses of joint ventures
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Mainly real estate partnership/JV effects including property revaluation and FX.
non_recurring_items.source: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income and financial review

funds_assets.item: Cash at banks and in hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Group cash held at banks and on hand; entity-level availability not disclosed.
Short-term bank deposits within cash equivalents.
Money market instruments classified as cash equivalents.
Broker deposits, treated as operating/trading infrastructure funds in owner earnback analysis.

investment_assets.business_substance: Listed securities, debt investments, listed and unlisted investment funds, including seed capital and associates.
Investment property, including property securing bank borrowing.

other_assets.business_substance: Residual assets including deposits for investments, amounts receivable on investment sales, prepayments, other assets, intangible assets and deferred tax assets.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Bank loan secured by New Zealand investment property; current maturity within one year.
Office and property lease liabilities used in continuing operations.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Ordinary operation accruals including compensation, IT, legal/professional, office and research expenses.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Core fee business was loss-making before other gains/losses in 2022-2024. Reported profit is heavily affected by proprietary investments, FX and JV movements, so ordinary sustainable distributable cash profit is not established.

Bank loan secured by investment property, HK$'000.

gaps: No parent/subsidiary split for cash and money market instruments.
No instrument-level disclosure for money market instruments.
No exact regulatory capital surplus by licensed subsidiary.
Maintenance vs growth capex is not separately disclosed; total PPE/intangible purchase used as conservative capex proxy.
